title: History reveal after bottom-origin scroll can show a false new-response popup
outcome: When the user begins scrolling from the live bottom, virtualized history residency can prepend older messages. SessionPaneView.scroll currently treats the resulting broad conversation-signature change as unseen tail content after detachment, so a New response/New activity popup can appear even though no new tail content arrived. Separate tail/pending-prompt advancement from resident-prefix changes: scrolling/history reveal alone must not arm the indicator, while a genuine assistant tail update or queued prompt arriving after detachment still must.
acceptance: A bottom-origin scroll followed only by older-history residency changes leaves the new-response indicator hidden; actual assistant tail growth while detached still shows New response; actual queued-prompt growth while detached still shows New activity; focused scroll tests, TypeScript, Vitest, and production UI build pass.
